title: WildReward: Learning Reward Models from In-the-Wild Human Interactions
authors_zh: Hao Peng、Junjia Qi、Xiaozhi Wang、Yijun Yao、Lei Hou、Yuanzi Li
paper_type_zh: 真实人类交互奖励数据与奖励模型论文
best_for_zh: 研究偏好数据、奖励建模或对齐的读者。
one_line: The paper provides preference or reward feedback data for alignment research.
WildReward 从真实人类交互中学习奖励模型，提供面向开放场景的偏好反馈数据。
why: It makes a feedback object available for alignment training, evaluation, or analysis.
inclusion_reason: The paper releases or uses preference or reward feedback data relevant to alignment.

title: Problem
问题
html: Conventional reward models depend on explicit human preference pairs collected for annotation, even though deployed assistants already receive abundant implicit signals through follow-up behavior. A user who accepts, reformulates, challenges, or abandons a conversation reveals satisfaction without clicking a preference label. The paper asks whether these naturally occurring interaction patterns can be converted into reliable ordinal rewards and whether reward models trained on them can support ranking and online preference optimization.
传统奖励模型依赖专门收集和人工标注的显式偏好对，但已部署助手每天都会产生大量隐式反馈。用户接受回答、继续追问、改写问题、质疑模型或停止对话，都可能反映满意度，却没有直接 chosen–rejected 标签。论文研究能否把这些自然交互行为转化为可靠的有序奖励，并用于训练能够支持回应排序和在线偏好优化的奖励模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: WildReward uses WildChat conversations to construct WildFB, about 186,000 high-quality interaction instances labeled with five ordered satisfaction levels derived from subsequent user behavior. Instead of converting every record into a pair, the model is trained through ordinal regression directly on the feedback level. The contribution is an implicit-feedback contract grounded in real user continuation behavior, plus a reward model and online-DPO demonstration showing how scalar ordinal signals can replace costly explicit comparisons.
WildReward 从 WildChat 真实对话中构建 WildFB，得到约 18.6 万条高质量交互记录，并根据用户后续行为标注五级满意度。它不把所有记录强行转成偏好对，而是直接使用有序回归学习反馈等级。其贡献是以真实用户后续交互为依据的隐式反馈契约，以及相应奖励模型和在线 DPO 实验，说明有序标量信号能够在一定程度上替代昂贵的显式比较。

title: Method
方法
html: The pipeline identifies assistant turns with observable user follow-up, filters low-information or ambiguous interactions, and maps behavioral patterns to ordered satisfaction categories. The resulting prompt, response, conversation context, behavioral evidence, and ordinal label form WildFB. WildReward is trained to predict the ordered level rather than a binary preference. The authors evaluate ranking, calibration, and cross-sample consistency, study performance as user diversity increases, and use the reward model to select online DPO pairs from newly sampled responses.
流程定位具有可观察用户后续行为的助手轮次，过滤信息不足或含义模糊的交互，再把不同后续行为模式映射为有序满意度类别。最终记录包含 prompt、回应、对话上下文、行为证据和等级标签，形成 WildFB。WildReward 学习预测有序等级，而非二元偏好。作者评测排序、校准和跨样本一致性，分析用户多样性增加的影响，并用奖励模型从新采样回应中选择在线 DPO 偏好对。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper compares WildReward with conventional pairwise reward models on multiple reward benchmarks, calibration tests, and consistency evaluations, reporting comparable or superior performance. A user-diversity ablation shows that adding more distinct users improves the model, supporting the claim that the signal comes from heterogeneous real interactions rather than duplicate volume alone. Online DPO guided by WildReward improves several downstream tasks. These converging tests support usefulness, but behavioral labels remain proxies: follow-up actions do not uniquely reveal satisfaction or correctness.
论文在多个奖励 benchmark、校准测试和一致性评测中，将 WildReward 与传统成对奖励模型比较，报告相当或更优的表现。用户多样性消融显示，增加不同用户比单纯堆叠重复交互更能改善模型，支持信号确实来自异质真实行为。由 WildReward 指导的在线 DPO 还提升了多个下游任务。多类证据共同支持其效用，但行为标签仍只是代理：继续追问或结束对话并不能唯一表示满意或正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier implicit-feedback work often reduces behavior to clicks, acceptance, or binary continuation, while reward-model training typically assumes explicit chosen–rejected pairs. WildReward changes the data object to an ordinal record derived from conversational behavior and trains directly with ordinal regression. Its novelty is connecting in-the-wild multi-turn interaction patterns to a five-level reward scale and demonstrating direct use in online DPO. The underlying ordinal model is established; the new contribution is the extraction and validation pipeline.
以往隐式反馈研究常把行为简化为点击、接受或是否继续，而奖励模型训练通常假设已有 chosen–rejected 对。WildReward 将数据对象改为从对话行为推导的五级有序记录，并直接使用有序回归训练。其新意是把真实多轮交互模式连接到五级奖励尺度，并证明该信号可进一步用于在线 DPO。有序模型本身并不新，真正贡献是提取、过滤和验证流程。

title: Limitations
局限
html: User behavior is confounded by curiosity, frustration, topic difficulty, interface habits, and time constraints, so the same action can indicate different satisfaction levels. WildChat users are not representative of all populations, and privacy-sensitive content requires careful release filtering. The mapping rules may embed cultural or platform-specific assumptions. Reuse should validate labels with direct human ratings on a stratified sample, preserve conversational context, and report performance by behavior type, topic, language, and user cohort.
用户行为会受到好奇、挫折、主题难度、界面习惯和时间限制影响，同一动作可能对应不同满意度。WildChat 用户也不代表所有群体，且真实对话包含隐私敏感内容，需要严格过滤。行为到等级的映射规则可能带有文化或平台假设。复用时应在分层样本上用直接人工评分验证标签，保留完整对话上下文，并按行为类型、主题、语言和用户群体分别报告性能。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: WildFB can train ordinal reward models without manually producing response pairs, and its labels can be converted into pairs when DPO requires them. The pipeline is useful for product logs where follow-up behavior is available but explicit voting is sparse. Researchers can study calibration, user diversity, and satisfaction prediction from conversation context. It should not be used to infer individual mental state or to treat silence and abandonment as universally negative; local behavior semantics and privacy policies must be validated first.
WildFB 可在无需人工构造成对回应的情况下训练有序奖励模型，也可在 DPO 需要时根据等级转成偏好对。该流程适合拥有后续交互日志、但显式投票稀少的产品环境，可研究校准、用户多样性和基于上下文的满意度预测。它不能用于推断个体心理状态，也不能把沉默或离开普遍解释为负反馈；迁移前必须验证本地行为语义和隐私政策。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: WildReward replaces explicit pairs with five-level satisfaction labels extracted from real WildChat follow-up behavior. WildFB contains about 186,000 filtered instances, and the reward model is trained by ordinal regression. Evidence includes benchmark comparisons, calibration, consistency, user-diversity scaling, and online-DPO gains. The main value is realistic implicit feedback; the main risk is confounding because behavior is not a unique expression of preference. Direct-rating validation on local logs is the required reuse check.
WildReward 用从 WildChat 后续行为提取的五级满意度替代显式偏好对，WildFB 约含 18.6 万条过滤后的记录，奖励模型使用有序回归训练。证据包括 benchmark 对比、校准、一致性、用户多样性扩展和在线 DPO 增益。最大价值是真实隐式反馈，最大风险是行为受到多种因素混杂，不能唯一表达偏好。因此，迁移到本地日志前必须用直接人工评分验证映射。
